name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Moon Drop (I)
description:
Sweet, dark, and made for after hours. The Cheech & Chong Moon Drop cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Moon Drop brings a deep, fruit-forward profile: sweet dark grape and berry notes up front with a jammy, candy-like sweetness and a smooth, mellow finish. Blended with an indica terpene profile for a relaxed, easygoing feel — the kind of quiet calm that suits late nights and slow evenings.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Moon Drop flavor — sweet dark grape and berry with a jammy finish
Indica terpene blend — relaxing and mellow, ideal for evenings
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Sweet flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Moon Drop is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
